description.value: Bodega on Main is an updated take on a long-standing Vancouver Spanish tapas institution, serving authentic tapas made with locally sourced and specialty imported ingredients, including OceanWise certified seafood. The 75-seat lounge and dining area features custom leather seating, hand-carved bar stools, and a blend of vintage artwork and antique accents. Touring cyclists will find a full-service sit-down restaurant with a well-stocked bar, takeout options, and delivery partnerships.
